name: Aizawa Tomoya
source:
[url=/c124678]Yukinari[/url]'s childhood friend who died prior to the events of the game.

He was frequently bullied and ostracized by his classmates because his family was poor and, prior to Yukinari transferring to his school, he had no friends. 

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Tomoya_Aizawa]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
